primary_docs.title: scheduler_job
primary_docs.supports: One target union; HTTP/App Engine headers/body and Pubsub attributes/data are literal string maps and base64 byte fields.

primary_docs.title: scheduler_list
primary_docs.supports: Native v1 jobs list uses pageSize/pageToken and jobs/nextPageToken.

primary_docs.title: appengine_version
primary_docs.supports: envVariables and buildEnvVariables maps are returned only in full-view GETs; name/id bind the version.

primary_docs.title: appengine_get
primary_docs.supports: GET exact apps/services/versions resource; default basic representation cannot establish empty env maps.

primary_docs.title: appengine_view
primary_docs.supports: The native REST enum is FULL, despite prose mentioning FULL_VIEW elsewhere.

primary_docs.title: workflow
primary_docs.supports: sourceContents holds deployed program text up to 128KB; revisionId has six digits, hyphen, three hexadecimal characters; ACTIVE identifies deployed state.

primary_docs.title: workflow_get
primary_docs.supports: GET accepts revisionId to read the exact discovered revision; no execution endpoint is required.

primary_docs.title: workflow_list
primary_docs.supports: List workflows under one project/location with bounded native pagination before source GET.

primary_docs.title: secret_manager_libraries
primary_docs.supports: Application code and authorized tooling can retrieve secrets using client libraries; this collector never calls them.

primary_docs.title: workflow_runtime_secrets
primary_docs.supports: Workflow source can call the Secret Manager connector at runtime rather than embedding credentials; this collector does not execute the workflow.

primary_docs.title: workflow_locations
primary_docs.supports: Native location enumeration is read-only and paginated.

tests.post_test_change: Only service-specific remediation declaration text changed after the 102-test focused run; all nine native current-source producer-to-MemoIndex cases were regenerated successfully afterward.

checks.producer: prepare_scope -> existing scheduler located/pages -> proposed early read_projected -> scheduler_scrub -> finish_scheduler_scrub -> real envelope
checks.consumer: scheduler -> evaluate; exact job/project, target union, complete envelope and complete bounded dual-engine marker
checks.omission: Omitted map/body on a full unmasked target means empty literal map/bytes; absent target, ambiguous union, redacted names-only raw input, invalid binary/base64 and empty Pubsub message UNKNOWN.
checks.metadata: Preserves URI scheme/host/path without userinfo/query, method, topic, App Engine routing, schedule/state and token configuration references; names-only target maps survive unchanged old scrub. Free-form descriptions and last-target error messages omitted before caching.
checks.calls: Reuses current location/job list reads; default no detectors and no additional reads. Default metadata branch removes literals and provider markers before legacy cache.

checks.producer: existing native list_services -> masked list_versions -> appengine_jobs -> authorized view=FULL fields=name,id,envVariables,buildEnvVariables GET -> read_projected -> real envelope
checks.consumer: appengine -> evaluate; exact apps/project/service/version and pinned complete dual-engine coverage for both maps
checks.omission: Omitted maps are empty only on the exact authorized full-view projected GET. Existing partial masked versions cannot prove absence, and mask violations or source inventory partial/ambiguous are UNKNOWN.
checks.calls: At most one additional read per returned proven version, named/boolean opt-in only; default masks unchanged; no deployment files/code reads.

checks.producer: workflow_jobs completes bounded location/workflow discovery, keeps validated name/revision summaries, then gets exact revisionId -> read_projected -> real envelope
checks.consumer: workflow -> evaluate; exact project/workflow/native revision matches observed revision, ACTIVE state and complete sourceContents scan
checks.omission: Missing/empty source, wrong/missing revision, unavailable state, unreachable locations, foreign/duplicate discovery or incomplete pagination are UNKNOWN. No source decoding or template evaluation.
checks.calls: New default-excluded workflow_source inventory; discovery and GET only after named/boolean opt-in plus explicitly requested project; never executions or managed secret reads.

authorization: engine binding from explicitly named check to precise kind; caller private list overwritten by root
scope must be an explicitly requested project ID, never inferred from discovery
exact native GET endpoint/query + producer-authorized dependent-read tuple precede credentials
stream_contract: Identity encoding only, bounded Content-Length equality or successfully completed Requests chunk framing; malformed/conflicting/absent framing, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite JSON, truncation, cancellation and read failures never establish completeness.
privacy: Literal values/maps/bodies/source, raw native errors and caller authentication are not cached or retained in receipts; isolated content operations bypass generic transport cache. Persistent scan data are HMAC fingerprints, detector labels, fixed surface paths, bytes and engine coverage. Native resource identities and safe existing metadata references remain for ownership.

verdicts.FAIL: Supported likely secret in returned selected literal surfaces, only after complete pair and complete inventory.
verdicts.PASS: No supported match in those returned literal surfaces only; no claim about all configuration/history, managed secret contents or usability.
verdicts.UNKNOWN: Disabled/unnamed/discovered scope, denied/partial/malformed/ambiguous subject, unproven masks/revisions, bounds/time/cancellation/framing or either detector failure, including partial positives.

actual_tools.proof: Actual pinned positives on all Scheduler targets, both App Engine maps and Workflow source; pinned negative per candidate, value fingerprint/merged detectors, cross-check one-value finding and no raw values/auth in collections/cache/evidence/output.

runtime_cases.pipeline: Native mocked HTTP and real producer/envelope -> sealed snapshot -> engine._index -> MemoIndex -> pure callback; App Engine service/version source inventories use their real native masked producers.

attribution: Shared offline peaso.secret_scanning and shared value dedup peaso.secret_findings.
Existing Function/Logging review detector and in-memory transport-hook test patterns reused with attribution; directed native target/enum/revision/default metadata tests added.
known_unproved_branches: Root shared hooks, registration/catalog/copy, default/category/framework/collect_all selection and private option overwrite admission remain uninstalled/unproved by this worker.
No live IAM, regional availability, quotas, production throughput or hard real-time SDK/OS scheduling guarantees.

Only selected literal Scheduler maps/UTF8 body/data, returned App Engine env maps and returned Workflow source are assessed; URI/path contents, descriptions, generated auth, Workflows userEnvVars, other metadata, runtime expansions and managed secret values are outside the predicate.
Strict standard canonical base64/UTF8 only; URL-safe/unpadded/binary payloads are conservatively UNKNOWN, not decoded recursively.
Domain-scoped/legacy App Engine application IDs and numeric-to-canonical project aliases remain unsupported rather than inferred.
Native identities and safe existing target names/references are retained; arbitrary resource identifiers cannot be certified universally free of user-chosen sensitive text.
Workflow GET pins the revision observed during discovery, not an atomic guarantee that it remains latest when collection finishes.
Detector pattern completeness, credential validity, target reachability, execution behavior and Secret Manager resolution are unproved.

declarations.title: Scheduler target literals have no detected secrets
declarations.remediation: Remove credentials from literal Scheduler headers, payloads and attributes, and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Use native OIDC/OAuth for compatible HTTP targets, or send the job to a workload that reads secrets at runtime.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the returned scheduler target literals.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.

declarations.title: App Engine version environment literals have no detected secrets
declarations.remediation: Remove credentials from literal runtime and build environment maps, and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Retrieve required secrets in application code or authorized build tooling through Secret Manager using a narrowly scoped identity.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the returned app engine version environment literals.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.

declarations.title: Workflows deployed source has no detected secrets
declarations.remediation: Remove credential literals from workflow source and rotate confirmed exposed credentials. Retrieve required secrets through Secret Manager at runtime using the workflow service account with narrowly scoped access.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the returned workflows deployed source.
The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.
